comment: Per-chunk gzip-size ceilings in bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `vite build`. A chunk fails the gate when it exceeds its budget by more than slopPercent. Chunk keys are name prefixes ("index" matches index-AbC123.js). Initial ceilings were set ~5% above the first measured build with CodeMirror + Milkdown in place; re-pin deliberately when a feature grows a chunk, so the diff in this file is what reviewers see. Chunks without an entry are reported but never fail. Export (PR after #4): index re-pinned 10.5 -> 11.7 KB for the export dialog and commands; the lazy export chunks (docx, markdownPdf = pdf-lib + renderer, marked) get their own ceilings so a dependency bump that bloats them is caught even though they never load at start-up. Re-pinned index 11.7 -> 14.4 KB (measured 13.4 KB) for three deliberate eager additions since: the IndexedDB file-handle store (recent files reopen the real file), the keep-source-style block merge, and the incremental visual sync. All three run on the editing path, so lazy-loading them would delay the first edit. Re-pinned index 14.4 -> 17.4 KB (measured 16.2 KB) for image paste/drop: the paste/drop handlers and image node view must be present before the first paste, plus the image-title parse fix and new UI strings. The image service itself, the find bar, outline and format toolbar are lazy chunks. Re-pinned index 17.4 -> 19.5 KB (measured 18.2 KB) for tabs and locale support: the tab model, multi-document persistence and the tab bar are on the start-up path (a restored session opens in its tabs). The tab bar is deliberately not lazy: lazy-loading it made Rolldown move ~2.8 KB of shared app code (i18n catalogue, store) into a chunk named after react, which hid it from this budget instead of saving anything. Re-pinned index 19.5 -> 21.5 KB (measured 20.3 KB) for the settled open decisions: tab view state and reordering, text size / wrapping / line-number settings, recent-list editing and heading search in the palette. The sample document itself is a lazy chunk. Re-pinned index 21.5 -> 23.5 KB (measured 22.0 KB) for the bug hunt's data-loss fixes, which must run before any save or tab switch and so can't be lazy: the editor flush registry, the on-disk change check and overwrite confirm, the two-window storage merge and quota warning, and the shortcut guards. Export fixes (footnotes, images, PDF lists) live in the lazy export chunks. Re-pinned index 23.5 -> 24.5 KB (measured 23.5 KB) for the security sweep and in-app help: the visual pane's recovery from documents the parser can't handle, the Load web images setting (checked by every image before it loads), and the Help and reading links. The user guide itself is a lazy chunk. Re-pinned index 24.5 -> 25.5 KB (measured 24.4 KB) for the bug hunt's fourth part and the nesting guard: the lazy-chunk boundary and stale-build toast, Save As onto an open file, and the nesting check, which must run before either editor parses a document and so can't be lazy. Re-pinned index 25.5 -> 27.0 KB (measured 25.9 KB) for the fifth bug hunt's fixes on the start-up path: keeping CRLF line endings and the BOM on open and save, the two-window persistence merge, sanitizing recents, the visual pane's empty-line and failed-state guards, macOS shortcut handling and hints, and the palette's editor-only commands. Re-pinned index 27.0 -> 28.5 KB (measured 26.8 KB) for front matter: the raw-text helpers that skip it (headings, block split, document title), the export setting, and its strings; all run on the start-up or editing path. The text pane's YAML front matter wrapper loads eagerly as its own lang-yaml chunk (5.5 KB), budgeted so a dependency bump that bloats it is caught. Re-pinned index 28.5 -> 32.5 KB (measured 30.1 KB) for the sixth bug hunt's fixes on the start-up and editing path: text encodings (Windows-1252 and UTF-16 read and written back), following tabs and settings stored by another window, keeping edits and view across the start screen, the front matter editing guards in the visual pane, the incremental-sync widening, reference definitions kept in place, and the image and save races.
